title: OSGR: Observation-Support Graph Reasoning for Earth Observation Question Answering
title_zh: OSGR：面向对地观测问答的观测支持图推理

paragraphs.en: 提出OSGR两阶段框架用于对地观测问答，将GPT-4o准确率从49.3%提升至63.7%并降低执行步数。 Answering geographic queries over Earth observation (EO) archives requires solving a joint retrieval-and-derivation problem under strict spatiotemporal constraints. Existing LLM agents fail to ground observation items or suffer from search-space explosion. We propose OSGR, a two-stage framework that factorizes this search into offline symbolic concept deduction and online Relation-Conditioned Grounding. OSGR leverages an offline Observation-Support Graph to deduce valid target-to-result support paths at the concept level, and applies spatiotemporal compatibility kernels to instantiate grounded observation-item sets. On Earth-Bench and DisasterM3-Reason, OSGR improves GPT-4o accuracy from 49.3\% to 63.7\% while reducing the execution-step ratio from 2.9 to 2.5.
